title: 第2章 奇迹降临
content_zh:
月光如水，照耀在静寂的山谷中，一棵大树前，夏尘正在疯狂的出拳打向树干。

他的双拳已经变得血肉模糊，但是却丝毫不觉，反而击得更加用力。

手上传来钻心的疼痛，但是夏尘浑然不觉，这点疼痛与心里的疼痛相比，算得了什么！

测试失败、遭人白眼不算什么，夏尘根本就不在乎。但是相处五年的女友提出分手，转身投入情敌怀抱，即便性格再坚强，夏尘也不禁痛苦万分。

此刻，他只能用自残的方式来发泄心中的伤痛。

良久，夏尘终于有些累了，他靠着大树，回想起这几年和林梦如的点点滴滴，不由得心如火焚。

这一切都缘于自己没有力量，不能成为修行者！夏尘拳头捏得咯咯作响。

力量！我需要力量！我一定要修炼成最强大的力量！

夏尘忽然站起来，仰天怒吼：“我夏尘以热血明志，立此誓言！若我放弃对修行最强力量的追求，万劫不复！”

抬起受伤的手掌，忍着疼痛，夏尘咬牙把已经止血的伤口重新划开，然后挥着手掌，鲜血飞溅着洒向天空，显得触目惊心。

轰隆！似乎是响应他的誓言，漆黑的天空突然传出一声震耳欲聋的炸响，耀眼的雷光一闪而下。

巨大的雷霆照亮了夏尘的脸，显得他苍白的面孔那么地坚毅，那么地不屈。

在雷霆光芒最亮的地方，突然激射出一个只有鸽蛋大小，浑圆雪白的坛子！

这坛子莹润如玉，泛着淡淡的青光，但是即使是最炽烈的雷光，也无法遮掩住这光辉！

坛子象是有着自己的意识一般，没有丝毫犹豫，瞬间化成一道青芒，投入夏尘的身体。

良久，夏尘这才放下双手，他的表情忽然有些呆滞，象是遇到了什么无法理解的事情。随后，夏尘低下头，向着自己的小腹看去。

刚才他分明感觉有什么东西进入自己的体内，沉入小腹丹田后便一动不动了。

难道是幻觉？夏尘疑惑地摸着完好无损的腹部，就连衣服也没有破损丝毫，但是刚才的感觉异常清晰，不可能有错，而且小腹丹田处也确实感觉多了一样异物。

不过这多出的感觉并不是异物感，而是一种血脉相连的感觉，就仿佛是五脏六腑，原本就属于他一般。

夏尘不禁傻眼，心想这到底是怎么回事啊……

他抬头看着天空，虽然是黑夜，但是天空却是十分晴朗，没有一丝云朵，真不明白刚才的晴空霹雳是怎么产生的。

好在进入体内的异物并没有丝毫不适感觉，夏尘疑惑半晌，见没什么动静，也就渐渐放下心来。

不过经过这番折腾，夏尘压抑的心情倒是消失了大半，毕竟无论怎样，生活都得继续。

回到自己的房屋，夏尘象往常那样坐在床上，闭目开始修炼，这是他五年来必修的课程，无论能否修炼出真气感应，夏尘都没有一天放弃。

刚刚开始呼吸吐纳，在夏尘小腹丹田内，那沉寂不动的雪白坛子突然亮了起来，发出淡淡的青光。

立刻，茫茫空间中，大量无形无质的精纯的天地元气聚合而来，顺着夏尘的吐纳节奏涌入体内，最后进入到雪白坛子内。

瞬间，一股能量气团便从雪白坛子内诞生出来，充斥在夏尘的丹田内。这能量气团热乎乎的，感觉极为舒服。

夏尘眼睛猛然睁开，神情变得极度惊愕！

真气感应！五年来从未产生，几乎让夏尘绝望的真气感应！

夏尘全身僵硬，心砰砰乱跳着，他简直不敢相信，自己竟然修炼出了真气感应，这不是幻觉吧？

他又闭上眼睛，再次呼吸吐纳着，随着体内的雪白坛子继续吸收天地元气，真气立刻随着他的呼吸吐纳节奏变强起来，转眼之间便充斥整个丹田。

巨大的惊喜涌上心头，夏尘确定无疑，这热气团不是幻觉，就是真气，就是五年来他无时无刻，做梦都想修炼出来的真气！

哈哈哈……夏尘放声大笑，笑声中泪流满面。

老天没有负他，誓言产生奇迹，不用问，这突然的变化，肯定和腹内异物有关，那道奇异之极的雷霆，让他重新获得了新生。

良久，夏尘终于平静下来，开始静静的呼吸吐纳着。

真气就在漫长的呼吸吐纳中增强着，丹田处溢满真气后，便开始向十二条经脉流转，如果真气流转经脉再回到丹田，便形成一个周天循环。

真气周天循环是后天一重炼气境的标志。

修行的第一大境界是后天境界，所谓后天境界，便是修炼真气，锤炼肉身，修习武艺功法，由低到高共分为十重，称之为后天十重。

不过从修炼出真气感应，到真气周天循环，还需要有个过程，大多数人都需要数月甚至更长时间才能达到炼气境。

而夏尘，仅仅几个时辰之间，真气便已经循环了十条经脉，而且没有丝毫衰竭的样子。

当第一缕阳光从窗子照射进来的时候，夏尘缓缓睁开眼睛，虽然一夜没睡，但是他丝毫没有疲惫之感，反而神采奕奕，体内更是弥漫着无穷的力量，似乎眼前有一块巨石，也可以打碎一般。

夏尘抬起双手，真气从毛孔激射出来，吹动着手上的汗毛摆动着，在空气中发出轻微的嘶嘶声响。体内真气十二条经脉中流转不息。

体会着真气的强大力量，尽管无比真实，但是夏尘依然有种象是在梦中的感觉。

不知道这异物到底是什么，居然可以帮我修炼出真气。夏尘心想。

他走出房屋，正玄派内门弟子选拔总共三天，还有时间参加最后的测试。

嘭！大院的门突然被人一脚踢开，三名脸色不善的杂役闯了进来，为首一名少年满脸痞相，冷笑看着夏尘。

李非？夏尘一眼认出这少年是谁，不由得眉头一皱。

李非和两名杂役平素跟着严冰鞍前马后，关系非比寻常，和他经常作对，此番闯进来，看来来者不善。

“夏尘，起这么早想上哪去啊？”李非露出拉长声音讽刺道，“不是又去参加测试吧？哈哈。”

“你说对了。”夏尘淡淡道，“我的确是要去参加测试，怎么，有事？”

“可怜虫，你真是疯了。”李非不笑了，从怀里缓缓掏出一把匕首，“可惜，你就是想自取其辱都没机会了，从今天起，你就要在杂役村里消失了。”

“哦？你们想杀我？杀人可是要偿命的。”夏尘脸色丝毫没有变化，淡淡道。

李非残忍的一笑：“可怜虫，我们不是要杀你，而是要废掉你，再把你逐出杂役村，当然，你以后还可以靠要饭生活，一时半会死不了的。”

“是严冰让你们这么做的？”夏尘不动声色道。

“聪明！其实你本可以好好活下去的，不过谁让你跟严冰大人抢女人呢。”李非道，“你在大人眼里，连只狗都不如，所以，夏尘，认命吧。”

他挥了挥手，一名杂役缓缓抽出匕首，狞笑着走上前：“可怜虫，你说我是先挑断你手筋好，还是挑断你脚筋好呢，你自己选择一下。”

咚！夏尘一脚狠狠踢在他的胸膛上。

那杂役哼也没哼，如同断了线的风筝般飞了出去，鲜血在空中喷出一道长长的抛物线，他摔在地上，便一动不动了。

“混蛋，我们是遵从严冰大人的命令，你敢动我们一根汗毛，严冰大人让你死无葬身……”那另一名杂役气急败坏地道。

他还没说完，夏尘已经悄无声息站到他面前，一巴掌狠狠抽在他的脸上。

啪！那杂役剩下的话全部变成了毫无意义的呜咽，身子直线般的飞出，在空中吐出大半口带着鲜血的槽牙后，便一头栽倒在地上，彻底昏死过去。

“一群废物！”夏尘冷笑道，大步向着李非走去。

“夏尘，你想干什么？你不要乱来，你打我们，就是得罪了严冰大人，他可是正玄派的内门弟子。”李非惊恐地连连退后，只吓得心胆俱裂。做梦也想不到，夏尘居然这么强大。

夏尘一把扼住他的咽喉，将他凌空提了起来：“李非，你这只蝼蚁，我对你没有任何兴趣，不过你很快就能看到了，你的严冰大人，是怎么被我踩在脚下的。”

李非脸色青紫，呼吸艰难，却连一根小手指也动不了。

咚！夏尘抓着他，狠狠将他拍在院墙上。

轰！整面墙晃了晃，无声无息的倒塌。

李非鲜血狂喷，全身筋断骨折，脸色惨白如纸。

院落外面正有不少杂役经过，见到这一幕，惊得目瞪口呆。

夏尘丝毫没有理会，抓着半死不活的李非，大步离开房屋。

从现在开始，居住五年的村庄，还有杂役的身份，再不会和他有任何关系。

content_en:
The moonlight was like water, shining in the quiet valley. In front of a big tree, Xia Chen was punching the trunk of the tree crazily.

His fists had become bloody, but he didn't notice it at all and instead hit harder.

A heartbreaking pain came from his hand, but Xia Chen was completely unaware of it. This pain was nothing compared to the pain in his heart!

Failing the test and being looked down upon by others was nothing, Xia Chen didn't care at all.But his girlfriend of five years broke up with her and threw herself into the arms of her love rival. No matter how strong his character was, Xia Chen couldn't help but feel extremely painful.

At this moment, he could only use self-mutilation to vent the pain in his heart.

After a long time, Xia Chen finally got tired. He leaned against the big tree and recalled everything he had with Lin Mengru in the past few years, and couldn't help but feel burning in his heart.

All this is due to my lack of strength and inability to become a practitioner!Xia Chen clenched his fists loudly.

strength!I need strength!I must cultivate to be the most powerful!

Xia Chen suddenly stood up, looked up to the sky and roared: "I, Xia Chen, declare my will with my blood and make this oath! If I give up my pursuit of the most powerful power in cultivation, I will never recover!"

Lifting his injured palm and enduring the pain, Xia Chen gritted his teeth and reopened the wound that had stopped bleeding. Then he waved his palm and blood splashed into the sky, which looked shocking.

Boom!As if in response to his oath, a deafening explosion suddenly sounded in the dark sky, and a dazzling thunder light flashed down.

The huge thunder illuminated Xia Chen's face, making his pale face look so determined and unyielding.

At the brightest place of the thunder, a round, snow-white jar only the size of a pigeon egg suddenly shot out!

This jar is as smooth as jade, glowing with a faint green light, but even the most blazing thunder cannot cover up this brilliance!

The jar seemed to have its own consciousness. Without any hesitation, it instantly turned into a green light and plunged into Xia Chen's body.

After a long time, Xia Chen put down his hands. His expression suddenly became dull, as if he had encountered something incomprehensible.Then, Xia Chen lowered his head and looked at his belly.

Just now he clearly felt something entering his body, sinking into the dantian of his lower abdomen and then became motionless.

Is it an illusion?Xia Chen touched his intact abdomen in confusion. Even his clothes were not damaged at all. However, the feeling just now was extremely clear and could not be wrong. Moreover, he did feel that there was a foreign object in the dantian of his lower abdomen.

However, this extra feeling is not a foreign body feeling, but a feeling of blood connection, as if the internal organs belong to him originally.

Xia Chen couldn't help but be dumbfounded, thinking what the hell was going on...

He looked up at the sky. Although it was dark night, the sky was very clear without any clouds. He really didn't understand how the thunderbolt in the clear sky just happened.

Fortunately, the foreign object that entered the body did not feel uncomfortable at all. Xia Chen was puzzled for a long time, but when he saw that there was no movement, he gradually felt relieved.

However, after all this trouble, most of Xia Chen's depressed mood disappeared. After all, life must go on no matter what.

Returning to his house, Xia Chen sat on the bed as usual, closed his eyes and began to practice. This was a course he had to take for the past five years. No matter whether he could practice Qi sensing or not, Xia Chen would not give up for a day.

Just as he started breathing in and out, the silent snow-white jar in Xia Chen's lower abdominal dantian suddenly lit up, emitting a faint green light.

Immediately, a large amount of invisible and pure heaven and earth energy gathered in the vast space, poured into the body following Xia Chen's breathing rhythm, and finally entered the snow-white jar.

In an instant, a ball of energy was born from the snow-white jar and filled Xia Chen's dantian.This energy ball is warm and feels extremely comfortable.

Xia Chen's eyes suddenly opened, and his expression became extremely shocked!

Infuriating induction!A sense of vitality that had never occurred in the past five years and almost made Xia Chen despair!

Xia Chen's whole body was stiff and his heart was beating wildly. He couldn't believe that he had actually developed Qi induction. Isn't this an illusion?

He closed his eyes again and breathed in again. As the snow-white jar in his body continued to absorb the vitality of heaven and earth, the true energy immediately became stronger with the rhythm of his breathing, filling the entire Dantian in the blink of an eye.

A huge surprise came to his mind. Xia Chen was sure that this hot air mass was either an illusion or a true energy. It was the true energy that he had cultivated all the time and even in his dreams for the past five years!

Hahaha... Xia Chen laughed loudly, with tears streaming down his face.

God had not failed him and promised to produce miracles. Needless to say, this sudden change must be related to the foreign matter in the abdomen. That strange thunder gave him a new life.

After a long time, Xia Chen finally calmed down and began to breathe quietly.

The true energy is strengthened during the long breath. After the Dantian is filled with true energy, it begins to flow to the twelve meridians. If the true energy flows through the meridians and then returns to the Dantian, a cycle will be formed.

The circulation of true energy throughout the sky is a symbol of the first level of acquired Qi refining realm.

The first realm of cultivation is the acquired realm. The so-called acquired realm is to cultivate the true energy, temper the body, and practice martial arts. It is divided into ten levels from low to high, which is called the acquired ten levels.

However, there is still a process from cultivating the Qi induction to the circulation of Qi throughout the sky. It takes most people several months or even longer to reach the Qi refining state.

As for Xia Chen, in just a few hours, his true energy had circulated through ten meridians without any sign of exhaustion.

When the first ray of sunlight shone in from the window, Xia Chen slowly opened his eyes. Although he had not slept all night, he did not feel tired at all. Instead, he was full of energy, and his body was filled with infinite power, as if there was a huge stone in front of him that could be broken.

Xia Chen raised his hands, and his true energy shot out from his pores, blowing the hairs on his hands and making a slight hissing sound in the air.The true energy in the body flows continuously through the twelve meridians.

Feeling the powerful power of Qi, although it was extremely real, Xia Chen still felt like he was in a dream.

I don’t know what this foreign object is, but it can actually help me cultivate my true energy.Xia Chen thought to himself.

He walked out of the house. The selection of inner disciples of the Zhengxuan Sect lasted three days, and there was still time to take part in the final test.

Bang!The door to the compound was suddenly kicked open, and three servants with unpleasant expressions broke in. The first boy, a young man with a ruthless face, looked at Xia Chen with a sneer.

Li Fei?Xia Chen recognized who this young man was at a glance and couldn't help but frown.

Li Fei and the two handymen usually followed Yan Bing'an, and they had an unusual relationship. They often ran against him. This time they broke in, and it seemed that they were coming from bad intentions.

"Xia Chen, where do you want to go after getting up so early?" Li Fei said sarcastically in a long voice, "Aren't you going to take the test again? Haha."

"You're right." Xia Chen said calmly, "I do want to take the test. What, is there something wrong?"

"Poor thing, you are really crazy." Li Fei stopped laughing and slowly took out a dagger from his arms, "It's a pity that you have no chance even if you want to humiliate yourself. From today on, you will disappear from the handyman village."

"Oh? You want to kill me? You have to pay with your life for killing someone." Xia Chen said calmly without any change in his expression.

Li Fei smiled cruelly: "Poor thing, we are not going to kill you, but to destroy you and drive you out of the handyman village. Of course, you can still live on begging in the future, and you won't be able to die for a while."

"Did Yan Bing ask you to do this?" Xia Chen said calmly.

"Smart! In fact, you could have lived a good life, but who asked you to compete with Master Yan Bing for women." Li Feidao, "In the eyes of adults, you are not even as good as a dog, so Xia Chen, accept your fate."

He waved his hand, and a handyman slowly pulled out a dagger and stepped forward with a grin: "Poor fellow, do you think it would be better for me to break your hand tendons or your hamstrings first? You can choose for yourself."

Boom!Xia Chen kicked him hard in the chest.

The handyman didn't even hum, and flew out like a kite with its string broken. Blood spurted out in a long parabola in the air. He fell to the ground and became motionless.

"Asshole, we are following Lord Yan Bing's orders. If you dare to touch a hair of ours, Lord Yan Bing will let you die..." the other handyman said angrily.

Before he could finish speaking, Xia Chen quietly stood in front of him and slapped him hard on the face.

Snap!The rest of the handyman's words turned into meaningless sobs. His body flew out in a straight line, and after spitting out most of his bloody molars in the air, he fell to the ground and passed out completely.

"A bunch of trash!" Xia Chen sneered and strode towards Li Fei.

"Xia Chen, what do you want to do? Don't mess around. If you hit us, you will offend Master Yan Bing. He is an inner disciple of the Zhengxuan Sect." Li Fei backed away in horror, and his heart was broken with fear.Never in his wildest dreams could he have imagined that Xia Chen could be so powerful.

Xia Chen grabbed his throat and lifted him up in the air: "Li Fei, you ant, I have no interest in you, but you will soon see how your Lord Yan Bing was trampled under my feet."

Li Fei's face was purple and he was breathing hard, but he couldn't even move a little finger.

Boom!Xia Chen grabbed him and slapped him against the courtyard wall.

boom!The entire wall shook and collapsed silently.

Li Fei's blood spurted out wildly, his whole body was broken and his muscles were broken, and his face was as pale as paper.

Many handymen were passing by outside the courtyard. They were stunned when they saw this scene.

Xia Chen ignored it at all, grabbed the half-dead Li Fei, and strode out of the house.

From now on, the village where he has lived for five years and his status as a handyman will no longer have anything to do with him.
